boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten verified no-cost outings on or near IU Bloomington, from museum galleries and historic tours to a nature preserve and an outdoor cultural program.

cards.title: Meet Washington at the Eskenazi
cards.subtitle: A free Revolution & Reflection stop at the Eskenazi Museum of Art
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the European and American gallery, compare details in Stuart’s portrait, then discuss how leaders shaped public images.
cards.short_summary: Examine an early presidential portrait together inside the Eskenazi Museum’s public galleries.
cards.evidence_claim: IU identifies Gilbert Stuart’s George Washington portrait as a Revolution & Reflection destination and states that no admission fee or campus affiliation is required.
cards.access_notes: Open to visitors without campus affiliation. Consult the page for current Eskenazi Museum gallery hours and campus-break changes.

cards.entity_name: The Social History of Indiana Murals
cards.title: Read Indiana History Across the Walls
cards.subtitle: Thomas Hart Benton’s murals at IU Auditorium
cards.notes: Walk the mural sequence with classmates, choose one panel each, and trade observations about the people, industries, and conflicts depicted.
cards.short_summary: Use Benton’s monumental mural cycle as the centerpiece of a free group art-and-history discussion.
cards.evidence_claim: IU names Thomas Hart Benton’s The Social History of Indiana murals at IU Auditorium as a Revolution & Reflection stop requiring no admission fee or campus affiliation.
cards.access_notes: No campus affiliation is required. Check the official page and IU Auditorium access information before visiting, as availability can change.

cards.entity_name: Dunlap Broadside of the Declaration of Independence
cards.title: See an Original Declaration Broadside
cards.subtitle: A free Lilly Library exhibition stop
cards.notes: Visit with a small group, inspect the displayed broadside and supporting documents, then compare what each person notices in the printing.
cards.short_summary: Gather around IU’s original Dunlap broadside for a close look at a foundational American document.
cards.evidence_claim: IU states that its original Dunlap broadside is exhibited at the Lilly Library through Revolution & Reflection, with no admission fee or campus affiliation required.
cards.access_notes: No admission or campus affiliation is required. Confirm Lilly Library exhibition hours before arriving; holidays and breaks may affect access.

cards.entity_name: Indiana University Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology
cards.title: Trade Stories Across the IUMAA Galleries
cards.subtitle: Archaeology and world cultures at 416 N. Indiana Avenue
cards.notes: Choose an object that sparks a question, read its interpretation together, and let each person explain what changed their first impression.
cards.short_summary: Explore cultural heritage and archaeological collections through a no-cost gallery conversation.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum’s official site says the Indiana University Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology is free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Museum of Archaeology and Anthropology: Indiana University
cards.access_notes: Free and open to all. Review the museum’s official site for current seasonal hours and closure notices before meeting there.

cards.title: Tour IU’s 1835 Presidential Home
cards.subtitle: A free docent-led visit at Wylie House Museum
cards.notes: Meet before the hour, join the guided tour, and compare the family artifacts and domestic spaces that reveal early IU and Bloomington life.
cards.short_summary: Step through a furnished 1835 home while a guide connects the Wylie family to IU’s early history.
cards.evidence_claim: IU Libraries states that free guided Wylie House Museum tours are offered to the public on Fridays and Saturdays with no reservation needed.
cards.source_title: About the Wylie House Museum | Indiana University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Public tours run Friday and Saturday, 10 a.m.–4 p.m., on the hour; the last begins at 3 p.m. Closures apply during IU breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Compare Contemporary Art at Grunwald
cards.subtitle: Free exhibitions inside IU’s Fine Arts Building
cards.notes: Walk the current show in pairs, select two contrasting works, and regroup to compare how materials or presentation shaped your reactions.
cards.short_summary: Turn a contemporary-art exhibition into an easy, conversation-led afternoon with friends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Grunwald Gallery’s official page states that all exhibitions are free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Grunwald Gallery: Exhibitions: Eskenazi School of Art, Architecture + Design
cards.access_notes: Open to the public Tuesday–Saturday, noon–4 p.m.; closed Sunday and Monday. Check the exhibition calendar before visiting.

cards.title: Take a Tropical Plant Break
cards.subtitle: A warm greenhouse walk on the Bloomington campus
cards.notes: Move slowly through the plant collections, pick one unfamiliar specimen per person, and compare visible adaptations before heading outside.
cards.short_summary: Share a quiet plant-observation session among the greenhouse’s living collections.
cards.evidence_claim: IU News identifies the IU Bloomington Biology Greenhouse and states that it is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Rare flowers from Jordan Hall greenhouse’s Agave americana: IU News
cards.access_notes: The supporting page confirms free public access but contains older hours and an older building name; verify the current entrance and hours before going.

cards.title: Walk and Talk Around Griffy Lake
cards.subtitle: A free nature-preserve outing north of campus
cards.notes: Choose a marked trail suited to the group, bring water, stay together, and pause at lake or woodland viewpoints for conversation and photos.
cards.short_summary: Trade campus scenery for a social walk through protected woods, wetlands, and lakeside habitat.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Bloomington states that admission to Griffy Lake Nature Preserve is free.
cards.source_title: Deer Herd Reduction at Griffy Lake Nature Preserve Completed for Season
cards.access_notes: Admission is free. Use the current City of Bloomington preserve information for trail conditions, operating hours, and temporary closures.

cards.title: Link Two Museums on a One-Mile Walk
cards.subtitle: An accessible route from IUMAA to Wylie House Museum
cards.notes: Start at IUMAA, follow Indiana Avenue toward South Henderson and Second Street, and use the walk between museums to swap exhibit highlights.
cards.short_summary: Combine conversation, light movement, and two cultural stops on an approximately one-mile route.
cards.evidence_claim: Healthy IU maps Museum Miles Loop 2 between the archaeology and world-cultures museum site and Wylie House, describes it as about one mile and ADA accessible, and says all museums on the routes are free and public.
cards.source_title: Physical Activity: IU Bloomington: Programs & Services: Healthy IU
cards.access_notes: The outdoor route is free; museum entry is also free and public. Check each museum’s current hours before starting the loop.

cards.entity_name: Granfalloon Daytime Festivities at Switchyard Park
cards.title: Catch Granfalloon in the Park
cards.subtitle: Free all-ages daytime programming on August 29, 2026
cards.notes: Meet during the afternoon for live performances, interactive activities, and installations; enjoy the free program without buying from vendors.
cards.short_summary: Spend a festival afternoon together with art, activities, and performances in Switchyard Park.
cards.evidence_claim: IU News states that Granfalloon’s 2026 Switchyard Park concert weekends include free, family-friendly daytime festivities and identifies an August 29 date.
cards.source_title: Granfalloon announces lineup for outdoor concert series at Switchyard Park: IU News
cards.access_notes: The remaining listed date is August 29, 2026. Daytime festivities are free and all-ages; food trucks and artisan vendors are optional purchases.

warnings: The Biology Greenhouse and Griffy Lake sources directly establish free access but are older publications; current hours and conditions should be reconfirmed before visiting.
The Granfalloon card is date-specific and applies to the free daytime festivities scheduled for August 29, 2026.
All ten cards have direct official evidence of free admission or participation; optional parking, food, or vendor purchases are not required.
